## Ledger verdict

- **p-side bridge:** VERIFIED
- **P135 slot hinge:** VERIFIED
- **Slot 2→3 alignment:** VERIFIED — p-side β rotation (n_j family)
- **Spend line:** rx3 = rx2 * β mod p  =>  Px3/rx3 = Λ
- **p-side y-bridge:** VERIFIED — lambda_y, CQ1, C_r1, IP+7=Py²; two y branches only (y, p-y)

- **N-side y-shadow:** VERIFIED — map_p_to_n, Lambda_N, lambda_y_N, GAP_x/GAP_y
- **CS-N Cq roots (N12):** RECONCILED
- **N-side p-rotation grids (N02–N04):** QUARANTINED
- **N-side rx slot map:** NOT_DIRECT — rx3/rx2 mod N ≠ ω₂ coset
- **Hinge:** Px3/rx2 = Λ1 (cross-slot); rotate denominator rx2→rx3 via β to recover Λ.
